text:
Raj Patel: Quick sync — CloudPartner train-the-trainer for the marketplace + joint webinar. Need SE demo runbook, landing page copy, and lead routing plan. Wed 4/14 10am PT proposed. Who can own enablement?
Emma Liu: I can own the landing page + registration flow. Will need hero copy by EOD Fri.
Zoe Martinez: I’ll draft the webinar narrative and benchmark callouts. Can we pick 2 clear customer stories to highlight?
Miguel Santos: SEs can run a dry-run. I’ll put together a 20min demo script + 10min Q&A plan. Need model/version to pin for the demo (so performance numbers are stable).
Aisha Noor (CloudPartner CSM): Partner side can provide a reference customer and share co-branded logos. We can also route partner-sourced leads directly to our partner pipeline.
Raj Patel: Awesome. Action items: Emma (landing), Zoe (narrative + benchmark), Miguel (runbook), Aisha (ref customer + logos). I'll coordinate lead routing with Sales.
Emma Liu: For landing I'll use this CTA sequence: 1) Register, 2) Request a demo, 3) Talk to partner. Any objections?
Zoe Martinez: Good. For benchmarks, want simple bullets — latency @ p95, cost per 1k tokens, and one qualitative note about hallucination rate on the demo prompts. Keep it non-technical for marketing.
Miguel Santos: Demo script will include a short performance note: "Observed median latency 220ms for 512-token runs on dedicated pool." We'll avoid raw numbers on public marketing but include in partner enablement doc.
Raj Patel: Perfect. On lead routing: marketing-bot, can we tag registrations with source=cloudpartner and send webhook to partner CRM + create SFDC lead with partner tag?
marketing-bot: @Raj Patel — yes. We'll add utm_campaign=cloudpartner_marketplace and a partner_source field. Webhook URL?
Raj Patel: I'll DM the webhook to you, marketing-bot. Also Sales: we agreed partner-sourced leads get routed to Partner SDR queue with SLA 24h.
Aisha Noor (CloudPartner CSM): We need a short training deck for partner SEs to run their own demos. Can Miguel share the runbook as a one-pager we can co-brand?
Miguel Santos: Yes — I'll produce runbook + a condensed one-pager (PDF) by Tue. Will include a quick troubleshooting FAQ and the demo prompts.
Emma Liu: For assets timeline: hero + registration copy by Fri, email nurture sequence by Mon, social kit (1 hero gif + 3 posts) by Tue.
Zoe Martinez: Webinar narrative draft by Thu. I'll include two benchmark slides and a short customer quote placeholder.
Raj Patel: Meeting scheduled: Wed 4/14 10:00 PT. calendar-bot created event: https://calendar.example.com/event/abc123 — invite includes partner CSM, SE lead, content.
calendar-bot: Event created and invites sent to participants.
Emma Liu: Quick question — registration form should capture: name, email, company, role, interested-in (hosted/dedicated/private), and partner opt-in checkbox. Confirm?
Aisha Noor (CloudPartner CSM): Confirmed. Also add a field: "Are you evaluating marketplace deployment? (Y/N)" so partner can prioritize.
Miguel Santos: For the demo runbook code snippet I’ll include this sample prompt block:
```
Prompt: "Generate a 3-step onboarding checklist for integrating Redwood Inference into a multitenant SaaS product."
Context: small sample dataset, 512 tokens, deterministic sampling
Expected output: concise enumerated steps, config hints, link to docs
```
Zoe Martinez: That prompt is great for the customer-facing demo; I’ll use a sanitized transcript for the webinar.
Raj Patel: One more routing detail — marketing signups -> segment track event name: "cloudpartner_webinar_registration" with trait partner=cloudpartner. Sales to pick via SFDC queue. Emma, can marketing-bot add that tag?
marketing-bot: @Raj Patel — tagging enabled. Events will include utm, partner, and lead_score default=0.
Emma Liu: I'll also add a hidden field to the form to append utm params so lead quality attribution works.
Aisha Noor (CloudPartner CSM): Partner wants a co-authored blog within two weeks post-webinar. Can content team commit to a post-webinar brief?
Zoe Martinez: Yes — I'll draft the post-webinar brief and outline within 48h of the webinar.
Raj Patel: Summary racking: deliverables + owners + due dates. I'll post a master checklist after this thread and assign tasks in Asana.
Miguel Santos: I'll prep the dry-run calendar 2 days before the webinar. Please list required demo infra: model version, dataset snippets, dedicated slot access.
Emma Liu: Noted. I'll share the registration URL once live and the creative assets folder link here.
Raj Patel: Thanks everyone. Quick check — can we confirm hero copy line by tomorrow EOD? If yes, I'll lock the promo schedule.
Emma Liu: Yes — will share hero copy draft by EOD. :thumbsup:
Zoe Martinez: I'll post the narrative draft Thu morning.
Aisha Noor (CloudPartner CSM): Partner will share logos and customer blurb by Mon.
Raj Patel: Closing — please react with :white_check_mark: when you’ve added your deliverables in Asana.
Miguel Santos: ✅
Emma Liu: ✅
Zoe Martinez: ✅
Aisha Noor (CloudPartner CSM): ✅
